lines.en: - What you doing? - Just sending a thank you text
to that guy that sent us the prank video.
Oh, yeah, I loved that bloody pickle bit.
Yes, bleeding snacks are always hilarious.
You wanna know the best prank I ever pulled?
I made a cop think his feet got cut off.
Oh, I'd love to hear the funniest prank you ever pulled.
Uh, I pulled some great pranks.
Like, once, when I was at boys' camp,
I filled this kid's hat with raisins.
And I'll tell you what, he wasn't expecting that in his hat.
- What about me? - Best prank you ever pulled.
They don't even count as jokes.
Well, then I guess I've never done one.
You've never pulled one prank in your whole life.
What about the stuff we do to Lubert on iCarly?
Yeah, that I come up with.
I guess I'm not the pranky type.
You're, like, way too old to have never pulled one prank.
I'm with Sam on this one.
She wrote, "Hey, I got an awesome idea for iCarly.
You and Sam meet me in our studio right after school."
Here's a sweet dessert from me to the iCarly's.
How do you get this up here?
I don't know, but there's no way I'm eating anything.
Thank you, but I couldn't have done it without help
from the king of pranks here.
Man, I forgot how much fun pranking is.
- Don't go getting all prank happy. - No, I won't.
How long did the doctor say you have to wear the cast?
Well, it's your own fault. You jumped up that pipe for nothing.
You said my cue was Gibby and I heard Gibby.
- Yeah, but you didn't hear the cue. - Guys, look, okay, yes.
I heard the cue was Gibby and I heard the cue was Gibby and I heard the cue was Gibby.
Yes, the cue was Gibby and I heard the cue was Gibby and I heard the cue was Gibby.
Somebody said Gibby and I heard the cue was Gibby.
You guys, take him back, so why don't we just let him go?
You guys got to do something about Spencer, the boy's gone too far.
He gave me this fancy face cream from Europe.
Says it makes your face all smooth.
Well, my face is already smooth.
So I gave it to my friend Lucas here.
Glow in the dark face cream?
What kind of sick man thinks that's funny?
Now he can't go see a movie.
Y'all better do something about Spencer.
What are we going to do?
I told you, you guys tell Spencer we're going bowling
and then I sneak up behind and--
He knew he had a problem.
He didn't want to help me, but I sucked him back into pranking
Look, I've seen this kind of thing before.
He's not going to stop until he hits rock bottom.
Spencer already hit rock bottom in ninth grade.
The garlic powder in all those kids' eyes?
Well, if we could all keep an open mind about the nunchucks.
Sam, what if we remind Spencer about what happened?
I could call those kids that he went to school with.
You know, so they can make him remember the pain
that his pranks can cause people.
Help me, help me, help me, help me!
My old classmates beat me up.
But they were just supposed to help you get the message
